description.value: One of 198 government-operated BCLIQUOR retail stores across British Columbia, this Commercial Drive location carries wine, spirits, beer, coolers, ciders, and non-alcoholic products. It sits on one of Vancouver's most bike-friendly streets and is operated by the BC Liquor Distribution Branch, a Crown corporation. Staff are described as knowledgeable product consultants who assist with food and beverage pairings.
